title: Ryan Cohen, Pres, CEO, COB at GameStop Corp., Buys Shares Worth $20.4 million
dek: Ryan Cohen (Pres, CEO, COB) purchased 1,000,000 shares of GameStop Corp., valued at approximately $20.4 million.
body: GameStop Corp. (GME) disclosed that Ryan Cohen, who holds the position of Pres, CEO, COB at the company, was involved in buying 1,000,000 shares, per a Form 4 filing with the SEC.
The transaction was executed at a price of $20.38 per share, for a total value of approximately $20.4 million.
Company insiders are required to disclose changes in their stock ownership to the SEC on Form 4, typically within two business days of the trade.
Insider buying is sometimes viewed by investors as a signal of confidence in a company's prospects, though a single transaction does not necessarily indicate a broader trend.

title: Snowflake Inc. Insider Selling: Benoit Dageville Trims Stake
dek: Benoit Dageville (Dir) sold 50,000 shares of Snowflake Inc., valued at approximately $16.8 million.
body: A Form 4 filed with the SEC shows Benoit Dageville, Dir at Snowflake Inc. (SNOW), sold 50,000 shares of company stock on 2026-09-09.
The transaction was executed at a price of $335.72 per share, for a total value of approximately $16.8 million.

Under SEC rules, corporate insiders — officers, directors, and holders of more than 10% of a company's shares — are required to report changes in their ownership within two business days of the transaction via Form 4.
Sales by insiders often reflect routine portfolio management or pre-scheduled trading plans rather than a view on the company's prospects.
